The '''Rantine Space Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Rantine Space Station was located on the edge of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], six days [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
